title: Very rare that politicians, public servants get involved in heinous crimes: Karnataka HC on Yogesh Gowda murder
description: The Karnataka High Court on Monday orally remarked that it was very rare for public servants or political leaders in Karnataka to be involved in heinous offences, adding that such instances appeared to be more common in some other States.The Court was hearing former Congress MLA Vinay Kulkarni's appeal against his conviction and life sentence in the case concerning the murder of BJP leader Yogesh Gowda. A similar appeal by co-convict Chandrashekar Indi is also being heard by the same Bench compr
